description.value: BAK'D Cookies is a sibling-run gourmet cookie café in New Westminster, founded during the COVID-19 pandemic and opening its first brick-and-mortar location in 2024. They specialize in oversized 5 oz handmade cookies baked fresh daily, alongside a café drinks menu featuring matcha lattes, iced coffees, and specialty beverages. The business is a certified BC Green Business and sources high-quality local ingredients.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, covered) at 32m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 35m; rack at 40m; rack at 43m; rack at 51m; rack at 85m; stands at 97m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms the business is open with an active ordering system. Address (285 Nelson's Court, New Westminster BC V3L 0E3), phone (604-520-0741), and website all match OSM tags. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; the website does confirm freshly baked warm cookies and hot café drinks (lattes, matcha), supporting hot food as true.
concerns: OSM category mapped as Groceries but business is a specialty cookie café/bakery — category may warrant correction in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible cookie café with a confirmed physical location and active online ordering. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and drinks in New Westminster.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag is shop=bakery, which maps to Groceries, but this is a specialty cookie café — a Café or Bakery category would be more accurate. Not grounds for exclusion.

Hot food.detail: Website states 'fresh out of the oven warm cookies' and menu includes hot drinks (lattes, matcha, tea)

wow_evidence: sibling-run gourmet cookie café, opening its first brick-and-mortar location in 2024
